value.name: Marylin thanks Wrigley for the berry spoons
value.description: Marylin recalls loving the berry spoons and thanks Wrigley, revealing a warm but slightly awkward exchange.
evidence: MARYLIN I loved the berry spoons.
I didn't have any. Thank you.

value.name: Miles presents the pre-nup
value.description: Miles tells Marylin that Wrigley has brought the Massey pre-nuptial agreement for her to review.
evidence: MILES Well, Wrigley brought something else for you today, darling.
MILES This -- is the Massey Pre-nup.

value.name: Miles emphasizes the pre-nup is ironclad
value.description: Miles invites Marylin to examine the agreement while warning her that it is ironclad.
evidence: MILES Marylin, you're welcome to examine it, but as you know -- it's iron clad.

value.name: Sarah confirms the pre-nup's reputation
value.description: Sarah interjects to confirm that the pre-nuptial agreement is indeed famous for being ironclad.

value.name: Wrigley explains Ruth could not attend
value.description: Wrigley says he tried to reach Ruth but could not get her, implying she is absent from the wedding proceedings.
evidence: WRIGLEY I tried to reach Ruth, but we couldn't get her.

value.name: Miles frames Ruth's absence as protection
value.description: Miles says they wanted Ruth present for Marylin's protection, reinforcing the legal caution around the marriage.
evidence: MILES We wanted Ruth here for your protection as well --

value.name: Judge Munson is introduced
value.description: Wrigley points out that Judge Munson is present and brings her over to the couple.
evidence: WRIGLEY The Judge is here. Over here, Judge Munson.

value.name: Marylin recognizes the divorce judge
value.description: Marylin realizes that Judge Munson is the same judge who presided over her divorce hearing.
evidence: MARYLIN Wasn't she the Judge at my divorce hearing?

value.name: Miles presents the wedding as closure
value.description: Miles acknowledges the short notice and says bringing the same judge is a nice form of closure.
evidence: MILES Yes. Short notice you know, but I think there's nice closure to it.

value.name: Miles greets Judge Munson politely
value.description: Miles greets Judge Munson warmly, signaling familiarity and confidence in the proceedings.
evidence: Hello Judge Muson. A pleasure as always.

value.name: Judge Munson questions the marriage
value.description: Judge Munson reacts skeptically to the couple's announcement and asks what is going on with them.
evidence: JUDGE MUNSON What's up with you two.

value.name: Miles announces the wedding
value.description: Miles states plainly that he and Marylin are getting married.

value.name: Judge Munson doubts the announcement
value.description: Judge Munson laughs and treats the marriage claim as a joke, prompting Miles to deny it.
